reasons: The lake judgment field states field_i_validity good_law as of 2026-06-30.
The lake scope note confirms that Gates replaced the Aguilar-Spinelli framework while Harris's penal-interest insight survives.
The lake has zero point overrides, zero accepted edges, and zero non-mentioned edges, but it also discloses proposed negative-candidate edges and audit_needed/cap_hit derivation flags.
residual_risks: Because the negative edges are proposed and classified as mentioned, they do not defeat the good-law call on the disclosed record.
A complete CourtListener audit would be needed to make an unqualified no-negative-treatment claim.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'no adopted negative treatment or point override in the disclosed lake record' instead of a categorical 'No negative treatment of Harris itself.'
